name: triage-bug-report
description: Walk through a bug report with structured form collection and a judgment step that produces a prioritised triage summary.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Steps to reproduce and observed behaviour

steps.description: Review the report and assign a triage priority.

steps.run:
jq -r '
  "## Triage Summary\n" +
  "**Title:** " + (."collect-report".title // "(untitled)") + "\n" +
  "**Reporter:** " + (.inputs.reporter // "unknown") + "\n" +
  "**Severity (self-reported):** " + (."collect-report".severity // "?") + "\n" +
  "**Priority (triaged):** " + (."assess-priority".priority // "?") + "\n" +
  "**Rationale:** " + (."assess-priority".rationale // "?") + "\n" +
  if (."collect-report".component // "") != "" then
    "**Component:** " + ."collect-report".component
  else empty end
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{triage_summary: .}'
